QuestInfo.name: Map of Turtle Island
QuestInfo.0: For your fourth mission, meet with #b#p2092001##k in #b#m251000000##k to find the #t4032472#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2092001# says that he will give you the map if you complete his request. He wants you to eliminate the bad pirates, #r#o9001029##k and #r#o9001030##k, who are harassing the people of #m251000000#.
QuestInfo.2: Once you eliminated the #o99001029# and the #o9001030#, #p2092001# gave you the #t4032472#. He says that it's not a place you can easily reach, so you shouldn't even try...

0.0: Are you an explorer? I feel a strangely powerful energy emanating from you. I suppose you've come to see me. What is it that you need?\r\n#b#L0#Do you have the #t4032472#?#l\n#k
0.1: You must be talking about the island I saw while fishing far out at sea. Yes. I have the map. I can't go out there anymore because of pirates, but I've still got the maps.\r\n#b#L0#Could you give me the #t4032472#?#l\n#k
0.2: There are lots of reefs near that island. And the winds are so strong, it is nearly impossible to approach. I've never made it myself. The island looks like a turtle covered in snow, hence its name, but very few people have even heard of it. Still want it?\r\n#b#L0#Yes, I'd still like the map.#l\n#k
0.3: Alright, I'll give you the map if you do me one favor. There are a bunch of Red-Nose Pirate #r#o7130104#s#k and #r#o6130208#s#k constantly threatening #m251000000#. Could you eliminate #r100#k of each?

1.0: You've eliminated the #o9001029#s and the #o9001030#s? Whoa! I'll gladly give you the #t4032472#.

yes.0: I'll tell you again, don't even think about going to Turtle Island. It's impossible.

mob.0: You haven't defeated #r100 #o9001029#s#k or #r100 #o9001030# monsters#k. Forfeit your quest and talk to me again and I'll send you to #m925110001#. I'll give you the #t4032472# when you're done.
